activity.notes: After the capitulation of Pavia in 774, Charlemagne assumed the Lombard royal title and remained King of the Lombards until his death in 814. This crown coexisted with his Frankish kingship and, from 800, his imperial title, so ATLAS records it as a separate overlapping polity Activity.
